source: Do not take this medicine on an empty stomach.
translation: Tome este medicamento con el estómago vacío.
back_translation: Take this medicine on an empty stomach.

planted.note: The translation drops the negation: the source says not to take the medicine on an empty stomach.

errors.explanation: The negation is lost: the source says not to take the medicine on an empty stomach, the translation says to take it on an empty stomach.
"Tome" is formal; the source sets no register.

revision: No tome este medicamento con el estómago vacío.
